description: A micro animated drawing in all 13 feature boxes and the end of A5 (plan.md steps 9-11; marketing-site tasks 37-39). Depends on FEAT-001 (roles.ts, KeyPicture and touch constants, RANKING_SENT, getSpellExample, finishedKeys, the stage/grid/bento CSS). Conversation (SaidStrip, ShowFlip, PhraseSave, WordAdd) and Privacy (DeviceBoundary, RankingSides, VoiceRows, ListenStrip) become 2 x 2 grids from 648px; Access (KeyLegend, TouchSizes, ScanPlay, ThemeHalves, LayoutBoxes) becomes the bento with the tall switch card. After this FEAT the page-wide tests pass, including MS-4.1.
steps: Step 9 of plan.md: new packages/web/components/site/pictures/Conversation.tsx with SaidStrip, ShowFlip, PhraseSave, WordAdd exactly as the design.md 4.4 rows (roles, step classes, play('frame'), finished states, texts from content.md §4 'Drawing text'); each root is aria-hidden with class site-drawing plus its own class, data-play and play('frame'). packages/web/components/site/sections/Conversation.tsx: site-grid site-grid--boxes, a 216px div.site-stage (aria-hidden) as the first child of each card before the h3; props { sentence, keys, spell } passed from packages/web/app/page.tsx (finishedSentence(demo), finishedKeys(demo), getSpellExample()). Remove SaidBubble, ShowCard, ShowFrames from Pictures.tsx and the .site-said rules (keep .site-show* rules ShowFlip reuses). Tests: replace the .site-frames--show and .site-said lines of MS-7.4 in site.test.tsx with the Conversation part of 'MS-7.4 the round-2 drawings are present'. Tick task 37 / 37.1.

Step 10: first add a 'Website drawings' section (the drawn computer key: surface-sunken, 2px line-strong, radius-chip, mono 16px label, 40px tall, at least 40px wide; pressed ring = the Key's 3px inner ember ring on an overlay) to design/system/README.md. New packages/web/components/site/pictures/Access.tsx: KeyLegend (keys 4, Enter, Backspace, the arrow pair with back icon and a still scaleX(-1); rings 0-1,1-2,2-3,3-4), TouchSizes (two KeyPicture '2' keys at TOUCH_MIN_SIZE and TOUCH_XL_SIZE with class site-key--touch, labels 72 and 128 in mono, rings 0-1 and 1-2), ScanPlay (KeypadPicture at KEY_DRAWING_SIZE plus a .site-scan__rings overlay with --row1..--row3, --key7, --key8, --key9 and the drawn switch, play('quick'), sequence of design.md 4.4), ThemeHalves (two halves with data-theme night/day re-declaring color var(--ink) and background var(--surface); KeyPicture '4' at KEY_DRAWING_SIZE and KEY_DRAWING_XL_SIZE in one 84px .site-cell), LayoutBoxes (36x64, 72x52, 96x60 boxes bottom-aligned, 8px gaps, 14px labels Phone/Tablet/Laptop; classes site-layouts__box--upright/--landscape/--wide, never 'phone' or 'device' in a class). packages/web/components/site/sections/Access.tsx: stage first in each of the 5 cards, switch card gets site-card--tall (384px stage that grows from 648px); the .site-note card keeps no stage.

Step 10 continued, remove all remaining A5 from site.css: the @supports (animation-timeline: view()) block with the nine frame rules, the scan named timeline and the nine site-frame-* keyframes, plus .site-frames, .site-frame, .site-frames--scan rules (rename the overlay to .site-scan__rings), and ScanFrames from Pictures.tsx. Tests: site-css.test.ts replace the MS-8.5 case with 'MS-8.5 no scroll-timeline property anywhere' (no animation-timeline, animation-range, view-timeline, scroll-timeline, timeline-scope; no scroll-snap or smooth scroll), drop the .site-frames MS-7.5 case, point MS-7.2's cursor check at .site-drawing .nl-candidate, set MS-8.10's keyframe count to the real total and assert site-fade-in, site-reveal, site-in, site-out, site-rise; site.test.tsx replace the scan line of MS-7.4 with the Access part and add 'MS-10.8 the Touch keys use TOUCH_MIN_SIZE and TOUCH_XL_SIZE' (also: every other single key wrapper uses KEY_DRAWING_SIZE or KEY_DRAWING_XL_SIZE inline). Tick task 38 / 38.1.

Step 11: new packages/web/components/site/pictures/Privacy.tsx: DeviceBoundary (class site-boundary; dashed line-strong boundary 'This device', four rows with check icons rising k0-k3, the 'Offline. Using your dictionary.' pill rising k4), RankingSides (Off row 'Off, the default' / 'Ranked on this device', On block 'On. Sent to rank:' with RANKING_SENT items rising k2-k5, outline ring on Off 0-1 and on On 1-6, play('quick'), no count, no provider name), VoiceRows ('Voice (en, on this device)' with check mark k1 and 'Keeps your words on the device' in k1; 'Voice (en, online)' with 'Sends the text to the browser maker' in k2; no browser maker named), ListenStrip (They said strip, 'Nothing yet.' out u3, ring on Listen 1-2, one .site-cell with Listen(mic) out u2, Stop(stop) during 2-3, Listen(mic) in k3; reserved status row 'Listening. Ask them to speak now.' during 2-3; the line 'What do you need?' in k3). packages/web/components/site/sections/Privacy.tsx: site-grid--boxes, 288px stages first in each card. Remove RankingSwitch, OfflineChip, their .site-switch/.site-offline CSS and .site-grid--2 (and its 600px rule).

Step 11 tests (task 39.1) in site.test.tsx: 'MS-7.7 every box card starts with a stage holding one data-play drawing', the final 'MS-7.4 the round-2 drawings are present' (13 box drawings plus HowScreen and ProofCheck), 'MS-8.11 every drawing's last change is at most 4000 ms' (for each data-play root and the How picture parts: lastChangeMs over every part's classes with the root's step length and a 700 ms lead), 'MS-8.11 every step class used on the page has a CSS rule', 'MS-7.3 no ember fill and at most one ember ring per step', 'MS-7.10 the ranking drawing lists RANKING_SENT with no count and the voice lines match the Voices card', 'MS-10.9 Conversation and Privacy use site-grid--boxes and the switch card is site-card--tall'; MS-4.1 must pass now; MS-11.6 must stay at most 15 KB gzip (else stop and send_message severity 'warning'). Tick task 39 / 39.1.
Add a docs/KIRO_LOG.md row for this FEAT with `node scripts/kiro-log.mjs add` (credits blank).
acceptance_criteria: `pnpm -F @ninth/web test --run` exits 0 with zero failures (MS-4.1 included)
site.css contains no animation-timeline, animation-range, view-timeline, scroll-timeline or timeline-scope, no .site-frames and no .site-grid--2 (site-css MS-8.5 and MS-10.9 cases)
every one of the 13 box cards begins with an aria-hidden .site-stage holding exactly one data-play drawing (MS-7.7 unit case)
MS-11.6 markup test passes at most 15 KB gzip
`node scripts/tm-lint.mjs` on every changed file exits 0; tasks.md rows 37-39 ticked; nothing committed
findings: MARKUP: MS-11.6 now 9,165 bytes gzip (was 7,705; limit 15,360), recorded in the test comment. TESTS: pnpm -r typecheck exit 0; web 377 of 377 pass (32 files), MS-4.1 included; tm-lint clean on the changed files. MEASURED on the dev server (Playwright MCP, Chromium): at 320 x 640 no drawing overflows its stage and no horizontal scroll; stage w x h / drawing content w x h: theysaid 240x216 / 224x172, showflip 224x154, phrases 224x138, wordadd 224x146, keylegend 224x184, touch 208x156, scan 240x384 / 240x376 (keypad 240 wide fills the stage exactly), themes 216x188, layouts 224x100; Privacy stages 236x288 (the site-card--line border) with boundary 220x248, ranking 220x224, voices 220x216, listen 220x186. No stage height was raised. At 1280 x 900 every drawing ends on its finished state and keeps no animation (getAnimations on #privacy only lists the A4 site-reveal of the cards, fill both, as before); screenshots in .playwright-mcp/ (git-ignored). CLASS NAMES (roots: site-drawing + one of these + site-play--*): Conversation site-theysaid, site-showflip, site-phrases, site-wordadd; Access site-keylegend, site-touch, site-scan (play quick), site-themes, site-layouts; Privacy site-boundary, site-ranking (play quick), site-voices, site-listen. Shared: .site-strip (They said strip, exported Strip({at: 1|3}) from pictures/Conversation.tsx, reused by ListenStrip) > svg + .site-strip__body > (.site-strip__label, .site-cell.site-strip__line > (.site-strip__empty, line)); .site-well reused in the stages. Access: drawn computer key span.site-kbd (+ site-kbd--right mirrors the back icon), the arrow pair span.site-kbd-pair with one ring for both keys; Touch .site-touch__col / .site-touch__px with KeyPicture className site-key--touch; scan .site-scan__pad > (keypad, .site-scan__rings > .site-scan__ring--row1..3, --key7, --key8, --key9), the switch .site-scan__switch > .site-scan__button > .site-scan__press (line-strong 3px, rings 3-4 and 6-7) + .site-scan__label; ThemeHalves .site-themes__halves > .site-themes__half[data-theme] (the Day half carries site-in k1), .site-cell.site-themes__key, .site-cell.site-themes__size; LayoutBoxes .site-layouts__col (rise k0-k2) > .site-layouts__box.site-layouts__box--upright|--landscape|--wide + .site-layouts__label. Privacy: .site-boundary__box/__label/__rows/__pill; .site-ranking__part (x2) > .site-outline (line-strong ring, 0-1 and 1-6), .site-ranking__row (drawn span.site-toggle[.site-toggle--on] > .site-toggle__knob), .site-ranking__note, ul.site-ranking__sent; .site-voices__row/__name/__check (mark k1)/__line; .site-listen__label (x3 in the drawn Listen's .site-cell), .site-listen__status (during 2-3). EMBER RINGS are only .site-key-ring, .site-press-ring and .site-scan__ring (the MS-7.3 test counts these per step); .site-outline, .site-scan__press and the proof boxes are line-strong. CSS: new custom property --site-piece on .site-stage (var(--surface); var(--surface-sunken) in .site-band--surface) gives drawn panels the card's surface; '.site-stage .site-well { background: var(--site-piece); }'; '.site-grid .site-drawn-btn { padding-inline: var(--space-3); }' (box grids only, not How); the full-width box drawings are calc(100% - var(--space-4)) wide, at most 336px. .site-show now uses --site-piece and padding var(--space-3). REMOVED: ScanFrames, ShowFrames, ShowCard, SaidBubble, RankingSwitch, OfflineChip (Pictures.tsx keeps only ProofCheck, no re-exports); CSS .site-frames*, .site-frame, .site-frames .nl-candidate, .site-frames--scan, .site-said, .site-offline, .site-switch*, .site-grid--2 (and its 600px rule), the whole @supports (animation-timeline: view()) block with its 9 site-frame-* keyframes and the scan view-timeline. site.css keyframes are now exactly site-fade-in, site-reveal, site-in, site-out, site-rise (globals.css has none). CHANGE OUTSIDE THE PLAN TEXT: KeypadPicture's KeyFace now puts a space text node between the digit and the letters (accessibility rule: keep the space in the DOM); a whitespace-only text node in the key's grid is not rendered, so nothing moves, and it makes content.md's '2 ABC' and '4 GHI' true in the page text (MS-4.1). TESTS CHANGED: site.test.tsx 'MS-7.4 the multi-frame drawings ...' replaced by 'MS-7.4 the round-2 drawings are present' (all 13 roots in card order, How screen x4, proof, and each drawing's texts and role classes); new 'MS-7.7 every box card starts with a stage holding one data-play drawing', "MS-8.11 every drawing's last change is at most 4000 ms" (17 data-play roots plus the How picture by data-s; step ms frame 600, quick 400, sweep 240, type 520; lead 700), 'MS-8.11 every step class used on the page has a CSS rule', 'MS-7.3 no ember fill and at most one ember ring per step', 'MS-7.10 the ranking drawing lists RANKING_SENT with no count and the voice lines match the Voices card', 'MS-10.9 Conversation and Privacy use site-grid--boxes and the switch card is site-card--tall', 'MS-10.8 the Touch keys use TOUCH_MIN_SIZE and TOUCH_XL_SIZE' (also: the 4 other .site-key-picture wrappers are the Your view keys at 64/84px and none sits in .nl-keypad); MS-7.2 no longer lists .site-frames. site-css.test.ts: MS-7.2 checks .site-drawing .nl-candidate and .site-drawn-btn cursor; the .site-frames MS-7.5 case is gone; MS-8.5 is now 'MS-8.5 no scroll-timeline property anywhere' (also no @supports (animation-timeline, no .site-frame(s) or site-frame-); MS-8.10 asserts the 5 keyframe names; SUPPORTS_VIEW constant removed. FOR STEP 13 (e2e site.mjs): section F still reads .site-frames--proof (gone since FEAT-002) and the drawn-key width check over '.site-key' must exclude '.site-key--touch' (72 and 128px). The 648-1023px tall switch stage grows with its row as designed 4.3 (V10). DOCS: design/system/README.md 'Website drawings' section (the drawn computer key); tasks.md 37, 37.1, 38, 38.1, 39, 39.1 ticked; KIRO_LOG row 31 (2026-11-11, FEAT-003, credits blank). Nothing committed.
